name: carousel-26
description: What's new modal-style card cycling through release notes with version badges.

files.content:
import { GiftIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious, } from "@workspace/ui/components/carousel" const releases = [ { version: "v3.2", date: "Nov 4", title: "Saved views", body: "Pin your favourite filters and share them with a link.", }, { version: "v3.1", date: "Oct 18", title: "Bulk edit", body: "Update status, owner, and due date on many rows at once.", }, { version: "v3.0", date: "Sep 30", title: "New editor", body: "Faster typing, slash commands, and inline comments.", }, ] export default function ReleaseNotesCarousel() { return ( What's new {releases.map((release) => (
{release.version} {release.date}

{release.title}

{release.body}

))}
) }
